generator: tools/blender/arch_build.py (+ arch_kit / arch_houses / arch_hero / arch_hero2 / arch_props / arch_infra); rebuild one asset: blender -b --factory-startup -P tools/blender/arch_build.py -- <name>
coords: All 'pos', 'size', 'bounds_*' and 'footprint*' values are in authoring space: X = right, Y = back, Z = up, fronts / doors face -Y, origin = centre of the footprint on the ground. three.js position = [x, z, -y] and is also given as 'pos_gltf'. Collider / walkable 'size' is the full box size [x, y, z] before 'rot_z' (radians around the vertical axis).
footprint: 'footprint' = [x, y] rectangle centred on the origin to keep clear / flatten (static mesh extent + ground anchors + 0.3 m margin). 'footprint_rect' = exact [min x, min y, max x, max y] of the static mesh.

node_types.walkable: WALK_* invisible box, stand on its top
node_types.anchor: ANCHOR_* gameplay anchor (door = 0.8 m in front of the door on the ground, npc, interact)

materials: Only contract material names are used. Every mesh has COLOR_0 (tint x baked AO, ground dirt, moss on roofs, soot at chimneys) and world-scale TEXCOORD_0 (2 m tiles for the tiling materials, 1 m for bark, 0.5 m for detail materials). Thin cloth (awnings, tents, sails, banner) is modelled double sided, so FrontSide materials are fine.

house_a.description: Small single-storey thatched cottage, half-timbered on a rubble plinth, gable chimney
house_a.notes: Rain barrel, firewood stack and bench are part of the mesh (inside the footprint, not in COL_body).

house_b.description: Two-storey half-timbered house with jettied upper floor, clay tile roof and stone chimney

house_c.description: Long thatched farmhouse (hipped west end) with an open plank lean-to shed on the east gable
house_c.notes: Lean-to shed on +X is open towards -Y; COL_shed / COL_shed_side only cover its back and outer side.

house_d.description: Narrow gable-fronted townhouse: jettied upper floor, shop window with counter and cloth awning
house_d.notes: ANCHOR_npc = in front of the shop counter (shopkeeper or customer spot). Awning cloth is double sided geometry.

tavern.description: Large two-storey inn: rubble-stone ground floor, half-timbered upper floor, tiled roof with dormers, front porch on posts, hanging star sign, side stable lean-to with stalls
tavern.notes: Porch deck is 0.25 m high: WALK_porch + WALK_step. ANCHOR_npc is ON the porch (z = 0.25). Stable lean-to (+X): front bay is passable, COL_stable covers the stalls. SMOKE_chimney = hall chimney (-X gable), SMOKE_kitchen = rear stack. Lantern by the door uses M_window_glow (no FIRE_ node).

forge.description: Blacksmith workshop: open-front timber shed on stone walls, stone hearth with hood and chimney, bellows, anvil on a stump, quench tub, tool rack, workbench, grindstone
forge.notes: Open front (-Y). FIRE_forge sits on the coal bed of the hearth, SMOKE_chimney on the stack. ANCHOR_npc = smith standing at the anvil. The water in the quench tub is a dark M_wood_planks disc (no water material in the contract).

chapel.description: Stone chapel: buttressed nave with lancet windows and slate roof, west bell tower with pointed-arch door, rose window, louvred belfry and slate spire
chapel.notes: Slate roofs use M_roof_tiles with a blue-grey vertex colour that greys the clay texture. GLOW_window is 0.6 m in front of the rose window of the tower. The tower walls are 9.6 m, the spire tip 13 m, iron cross to 13.75 m.

barn.description: Timber barn on a stone plinth: board-and-batten walls, big double doors, hay-loft opening with hoist beam, thatched roof
barn.notes: Doors are closed (not enterable). Hay-loft opening is a dark recessed panel with hay and a hoist beam.

windmill.description: Smock windmill: round rubble-stone base, eight-sided boarded timber tower with gallery, boarded cap with tail pole; four lattice sails with canvas as separate ROT_blades

nodes.name: ROT_blades
nodes.axis: local Y in Blender = local Z in three.js

windmill.notes: ROT_blades is a separate mesh (origin at the hub). Its node has NO rotation: spin it around its local Blender Y axis = local Z axis in three.js (node.rotation.z += w * dt); Y points to the back, the sign only sets the direction. Sail sweep radius is 5.05 m around the hub (0, -2.72, 9.55), so keep 5.2 m clear left/right of the tower above 4.4 m. COL_tower_a + COL_tower_b (rotated 45 deg) approximate the round base.

watchtower.description: Wooden lookout tower on four splayed log legs with cross-bracing, ladder, boarded platform under a thatched pyramid roof, signal brazier
watchtower.notes: ANCHOR_npc = lookout on the platform (z = 6.06). FIRE_brazier on the platform. The ladder is decorative (no WALK boxes).

well.description: Roofed stone well with windlass, crank, rope and bucket

market_stall_a.description: Market stall: timber frame, plank counter, red/white striped awning; cabbages, carrots, apples, bread, sacks and a barrel
market_stall_a.notes: ANCHOR_npc = seller behind the counter (faces -Y). Cloth is double sided geometry.

market_stall_b.description: Fishmonger's stall: trestle table under a blue/yellow ridge awning, fish on a slanted board, baskets, tub and crates
market_stall_b.notes: ANCHOR_npc = seller behind the table (faces -Y). Cloth is double sided geometry.

notice_board.description: Quest notice board: two posts, plank panel under a small shingle hood, pinned papers
notice_board.notes: ANCHOR_interact 0.8 m in front of the board (-Y).

signpost.description: Wooden signpost with two arrow boards on a stone-packed base

fence_wood.description: 3 m post-and-rail fence segment (centred, runs along X, tiles end to end)
fence_wood.notes: Runs along X, exactly 3.0 m, tiles end to end.

fence_wattle.description: 3 m woven wattle fence segment (centred, runs along X, tiles end to end)
fence_wattle.notes: Runs along X, exactly 3.0 m, tiles end to end. Weave uses M_rope (wicker).

stone_wall_low.description: 4 m dry-stone field wall, 1 m high (centred, runs along X, tiles end to end)
stone_wall_low.notes: Runs along X, 4.0 m between end faces (cope stones overhang by a few cm), tiles end to end.

palisade.description: 4 m palisade segment of sharpened logs, 3.2 m high (centred, runs along X, tiles end to end)
palisade.notes: Runs along X, exactly 4.0 m, tiles end to end. Logs use M_bark_pine, sharpened tips M_wood_planks.

palisade_gate.description: 6 m palisade gate: log flanks, big posts and lintel, plank doors swung open inwards (3 m clear opening), fighting platform above with ladder
palisade_gate.notes: Runs along X, 6.0 m wide, same line as `palisade` (outside = -Y). 3.0 m clear opening between x = -1.5 and 1.5, 3.3 m headroom. Flank logs are 4.7 m high. WALK_walkway (top z = 3.64) and ANCHOR_npc are on the fighting platform; the ladder is decorative.

cart.description: Two-wheeled farm cart resting on its shafts, loaded with sacks, a crate and hay
cart.notes: Shafts point to -Y and rest on the ground.

woodpile.description: Stacked split firewood between four stakes, chopping block with axe

bench.description: Rough plank bench on four splayed legs

table.description: Trestle table with three tankards, a loaf on a board and a candle

trough.description: Plank water trough on two sleepers

ladder.description: Wooden ladder, 3.6 m, leaning 14 degrees towards +Y (rotate it for other uses)
ladder.notes: Leans 14 degrees towards +Y (place it in front of a wall that is at y = +0.9).

lamp_post.description: Timber lamp post with a bracket and a hanging iron lantern
lamp_post.notes: FIRE_lamp is at the lantern (use a small flame / warm light). Lantern panes use M_window_glow.

brazier.description: Wrought-iron tripod brazier with a bowl of glowing coals

campfire.description: Camp fire: ring of stones, charred logs, glowing embers

tent_a.description: Small A-frame canvas tent with ridge pole, open front flaps, guy ropes and pegs
tent_a.notes: Entrance faces -Y. Canvas is double sided geometry.

tent_b.description: Round striped pavilion: central pole with pennant, conical roof with valance, cloth walls, open front, guy ropes
tent_b.notes: Entrance faces -Y. Canvas is double sided geometry; guy ropes reach 3.5 m from the centre.

bedroll.description: Bedroll: straw mat, blanket and rolled pillow

banner.description: Banner pole (4 m) with cross-bar and hanging swallow-tailed cloth; cloth vertex colour is white so the engine can tint it
banner.notes: Cloth vertex colour is pure white (no baked AO) so the engine can tint M_cloth per instance; cloth is double sided geometry.

scarecrow.description: Scarecrow: pole cross, patched tunic, sack head with straw hat, straw hands, a crow

dock.description: 6 x 2.4 m pier segment on four piles (runs along X, tiles end to end), deck top at z = 0.9, piles reach 1.8 m below the origin
dock.notes: Runs along X, 6.0 m, tiles end to end. Deck top z = 0.9 (WALK_deck). Piles go down to z = -1.8.

rowboat.description: Clinker-style rowing boat with three thwarts and a pair of oars (keel at z = 0, waterline ~0.22)
rowboat.notes: Bow points to -Y. Keel bottom at z = 0, waterline about z = 0.22.

bridge_wood.description: Plank bridge: 10 m deck (3 m wide, top at z = 1.0) on three pile bents with railings, plus 2.5 m ramps down to z = 0 at both ends (total length 15 m); walk direction = X
bridge_wood.notes: Walk direction = X. Flat deck x = -5..5 (top z = 1.0), ramps to z = 0 at x = +-7.5 (total 15 m). WALK_deck + 4 WALK_ramp_* steps per side (0.25 m each). Piles go down to z = -2.2. COL_rail_* keep the player on the bridge.

bridge_stone.description: Single-arch humpback stone bridge, 14 m long, 4 m wide, deck peak 2.2 m, cobbled deck between 0.85 m parapets; arch springs 0.6 m below the origin; walk direction = X
bridge_stone.notes: Walk direction = X. Deck z = 2.2 * cos^2(pi * x / 14) between the parapets (|y| < 1.65). 19 WALK_deck_* boxes in 0.22 m steps. Arch (6.4 m span, crown z = 1.6) springs at z = -0.6: put the water / river bed below. COL_parapet_* cover the parapets.
